disputes.reason: False only by exclusion from a recalled list; scenario design plausibly does consider sources of liquidity (buffer, facilities), so a candidate could argue it is true and the claim is not independently judgeable.

Explanation teaches something wrong: deposit insurance (FDIC) covers business and institutional depositors up to the limit, so the claim is arguably true and the 'not commercial' rationale is incorrect.

Absolute 'accepts only securities of the highest credit quality' overstates the preference; cash investors prefer high quality but also lend against lower-quality collateral at larger haircuts, so a candidate could reasonably call it false.
